verdict.rationale: Railway's homepage claims that HTTP, TCP, gRPC, and WebSockets are 'handled automatically.' Public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing are also described as live from the moment you deploy, which matches the story's no-separate-protocol-configuration premise. The support rests only on short marketing lines, with no in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that all four protocols can be served from the same single service at once, detailed networking docs (e.g. how TCP proxying and gRPC routing work), and independent or hands-on verification.
